beginner.summary: For data engineers, analysts and developers new to Databricks. Covers the workspace, compute, Spark concepts, DataFrames, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, transformations, semi-structured data, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader, the medallion architecture, Lakeflow Jobs, PySpark functions, AI/BI dashboards, table maintenance, Git folders, cost basics, BI connections and the Spark UI.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins and GROUP BY
Understands what a data warehouse or data lake is in general terms
outcomes: Load, transform and store data as Delta tables in Unity Catalog
Build bronze, silver and gold layers with SQL and PySpark
Schedule pipelines with Lakeflow Jobs and share results in dashboards
Keep jobs efficient and find problems in the Spark UI

days.topic: Databricks Platform Overview and Workspace Setup
subtopics: What the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform is
Lakehouse compared with data lakes and warehouses
Databricks on Azure, AWS and GCP
The workspace UI: workspace, catalog, compute, jobs and SQL
Free Edition and trial accounts for practice
days.lab_task: Sign in to a practice workspace, create a folder and a notebook, run Python and SQL cells against a sample dataset and note where each main area of the UI is.
days.deliverable: Notebook with Python and SQL cells and a one-page UI map
checks: Same row count as the SQL cell
Control and compute planes described correctly

days.topic: Compute on Databricks: Clusters, Serverless and SQL Warehouses
subtopics: Serverless compute for notebooks and jobs
days.lab_task: Create an all-purpose cluster with auto-termination, attach a notebook, run the same query on serverless compute and a SQL warehouse and record start-up time and cost per run.
days.deliverable: Compute configuration screenshots and comparison table

days.lab_task: Run a chain of transformations and one action on a large sample dataset, count the stages in the Spark UI, change the partition count and explain the difference.
days.deliverable: Notebook and Spark UI notes

days.topic: Reading and Writing Data with DataFrames
subtopics: Volumes for files in Unity Catalog
days.lab_task: Upload raw sales CSV files to a volume, read them with an explicit schema, clean nulls and column names, and write the result as a table, then repeat a write with overwrite and append to see the difference.
days.deliverable: Notebook and output table
checks: Read with a wrong type in the schema
Bad values become null and are counted
Row count back to one load

days.topic: Spark SQL and Databricks SQL Queries
subtopics: SELECT, joins and aggregation in Spark SQL
days.lab_task: Write SQL in the SQL editor to report revenue by month and region from the sales table, create a view for it, add a parameter for region and inspect the query history.
days.deliverable: Saved queries, view definition and screenshots

subtopics: What Delta Lake adds to Parquet
days.lab_task: Create a managed Delta table of customers, try to append data with a wrong column type, evolve the schema with a new column and upsert changes with MERGE.
days.deliverable: Notebook and table history output
checks: Updated and inserted row counts correct

days.lab_task: Join orders, customers and products, compute revenue per customer per month, rank customers within regions with a window and remove duplicate orders keeping the latest version.
days.deliverable: Notebook and result tables
checks: Broadcast join shown in the plan

days.lab_task: Load nested clickstream JSON, flatten events and their properties, store raw payloads in a VARIANT column and compare query speed and convenience of both approaches.
days.deliverable: Notebook, flattened table and comparison notes
checks: Query a nested field with VARIANT
Load a file with a new field

days.topic: Unity Catalog: Catalogs, Schemas and Permissions
days.lab_task: Create dev and prod catalogs with bronze, silver and gold schemas, grant analysts read-only access to gold and engineers write access to all, and test access as each group.
days.deliverable: Grant scripts and access test results

days.topic: Ingesting Files with Auto Loader and COPY INTO
subtopics: Schema inference and evolution in Auto Loader
File notification and directory listing modes
days.lab_task: Ingest daily order files with COPY INTO, then switch to Auto Loader with schema evolution, drop in a file with a new column and a corrupt file, and confirm each file is loaded once.
days.deliverable: Ingestion notebooks and load history
checks: Add a file with a new column

days.topic: Medallion Architecture: Bronze, Silver and Gold
subtopics: When to add or skip layers
days.lab_task: Build bronze, silver and gold tables for the sales data with clear naming, then rebuild silver and gold from bronze after a cleaning rule changes.
days.deliverable: Layered tables, notebooks and a design note
checks: Change a cleaning rule and rebuild
Silver and gold updated from bronze

subtopics: Notebook, SQL and Python script tasks
days.lab_task: Create a job that runs bronze, silver and gold tasks in order with parameters for the run date, a retry on the bronze task, a daily schedule and failure email alerts.
days.deliverable: Job definition and run history
checks: Gold does not run and an alert is sent

subtopics: Modules and imports from workspace files
days.lab_task: Replace a slow Python UDF that cleans phone numbers with built-in functions and a pandas UDF, register a SQL UDF in Unity Catalog and compare run times.
days.deliverable: Function module, UDFs and timing table
checks: Call the SQL UDF from the SQL editor

subtopics: When to use Power BI or Tableau instead
days.lab_task: Build a sales dashboard on the gold tables with a trend, top products, region filter and a daily email subscription, and share it with the analyst group only.
days.deliverable: Published dashboard and sharing settings
checks: Open as a user outside the group

days.topic: Delta Table Maintenance: OPTIMIZE, VACUUM and Time Travel
subtopics: Z-ordering and liquid clustering in brief
days.lab_task: Create a table with many small files, compact it with OPTIMIZE, query an older version with time travel, restore after a bad delete and VACUUM with the default retention.
days.deliverable: Notebook and before and after file statistics
checks: VACUUM then query an old version
Fails after retention passes and the reason explained

days.lab_task: Connect a Git folder to a repository, move shared functions into a Python module, make a change on a branch, open a pull request and replace a hard-coded password with a secret scope.
days.deliverable: Repository, pull request and secret configuration
checks: Change appears in the remote repository

subtopics: Compute costs from the cloud provider
days.lab_task: Query billing system tables to find the costliest jobs and clusters of the last month, tag compute by project and write a cost estimate for the course pipeline.
days.deliverable: Cost queries, tag settings and estimate
checks: Compute and storage costs both included

days.topic: Connecting BI Tools and External Systems
days.lab_task: Connect Power BI to a SQL warehouse with OAuth, build a report on gold tables in DirectQuery mode, then connect a Python client with a service principal.
days.deliverable: Report, connection settings and client script

days.topic: Debugging Spark Jobs with the Spark UI
days.lab_task: Run three slow or failing jobs (a skewed join, an out-of-memory collect and a cartesian join), find each cause in the Spark UI and logs and fix it.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes and fixed notebooks
checks: Task with far more data identified
Driver no longer runs out of memory
Join condition added and run time drops

days.lab_task: Build a retail lakehouse: ingest daily files with Auto Loader into bronze, clean to silver, build gold tables, secure them in Unity Catalog, schedule with a job and publish a dashboard, then demo a new day's file flowing through.
days.deliverable: Notebooks, job, grants, dashboard and demo recording
checks: Dashboard shows the new day after the job runs
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one lakehouse

intermediate.summary: For data engineers who build pipelines on Databricks. Covers Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, change data capture, Structured Streaming, layout and Spark tuning, Unity Catalog governance, Asset Bundles and CI/CD, testing, Lakeflow Connect, multi-task orchestration, SQL warehouses, Delta Sharing, MLflow, feature tables, slowly changing dimensions, monitoring, Terraform, cloud differences and Data Engineer Associate preparation.
prerequisites: Has built Delta tables and jobs on Databricks
outcomes: Build declarative batch and streaming pipelines with data quality rules
Tune Spark and Delta layout for speed and cost
Govern data with Unity Catalog and deploy with Asset Bundles through CI/CD
Prepare for the Data Engineer Associate exam

subtopics: Defining pipelines in SQL and Python
When to use pipelines or jobs with notebooks
days.lab_task: Rebuild the sales medallion flow as a declarative pipeline with streaming bronze, silver with expectations that drop or quarantine bad rows and gold materialised views, and read the event log for quality metrics.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, pipeline graph and quality metrics
checks: Rows dropped or quarantined as configured

days.topic: Change Data Capture with AUTO CDC
subtopics: Inserts, updates and deletes in CDC
Change data feed on Delta tables
days.lab_task: Apply a CDC feed of customer changes with out-of-order events to a type 2 customer table using AUTO CDC, then read the change data feed of silver to update a downstream table incrementally.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code and table history
checks: Send an update before its insert

subtopics: Sources: Kafka, Event Hubs, Kinesis and files
tools: Apache Kafka or Azure Event Hubs
days.lab_task: Stream order events from Kafka, compute five-minute revenue windows with a watermark, join with a product table, write to Delta with foreachBatch MERGE and restart from the checkpoint.
days.deliverable: Streaming notebook, output table and monitoring screenshots
checks: Send late events past the watermark
Revenue per window correct for sample data

days.topic: Delta Layout Tuning: Partitioning, Liquid Clustering and Data Skipping
subtopics: When to partition and when not to
days.lab_task: Load 500 million rows, test queries with no layout, date partitioning and liquid clustering on customer and date, and compare files read and query time.
days.deliverable: Layout experiments and results table
checks: Fewer with liquid clustering for the filtered query
Change applied without rewriting the table definition

days.topic: Spark Execution: Shuffles, Joins and Adaptive Query Execution
subtopics: Sort-merge, broadcast and shuffle hash joins
days.lab_task: Tune a slow gold job: read the plan, fix a skewed join, size shuffle partitions, enable Photon and record the run time after each change.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with plans and timings
checks: Run time compared with and without

days.topic: Unity Catalog Governance: Lineage, Tags and Fine-Grained Access
days.lab_task: Tag personal data columns, mask them for analysts, add a row filter so regional managers see only their region, trace lineage from bronze to a dashboard and query the audit log for access to the table.
days.deliverable: Policies, lineage screenshot and audit query
checks: Query a masked column as an analyst

subtopics: Targets for dev, staging and prod
Deploying jobs and pipelines as code
days.lab_task: Package the sales pipeline and jobs as a bundle with dev and prod targets, deploy it from GitHub Actions using a service principal and promote a change from dev to prod through a pull request.
days.deliverable: Bundle files, workflow and deployment history
checks: Deployment uses a service principal, not a user

subtopics: What to test in data pipelines
Unit tests with pytest and local Spark
Databricks Connect for testing from the IDE
Integration tests in a test workspace
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the cleaning functions, an integration test that runs the pipeline on a small dataset in a test catalog and a CI step that runs both on each pull request.
days.deliverable: Test suite and CI results
checks: Pipeline output matches the expected table

days.topic: Ingestion from Databases and SaaS with Lakeflow Connect
subtopics: Ingesting from SQL Server, Salesforce and others
Lakehouse Federation for querying without copying
days.lab_task: Ingest a SQL Server table incrementally with a managed connector, query a PostgreSQL table in place through Lakehouse Federation and compare freshness, cost and source load.
days.deliverable: Connector configuration, federation setup and comparison
checks: Change arrives in the next ingestion run
Freshness, cost and source load compared

subtopics: Orchestrating with Airflow or Azure Data Factory
days.lab_task: Build a workflow that loads data for each of five countries with a for-each task, runs quality checks, branches on the result and triggers a pipeline, then repair a failed run.
days.deliverable: Job definition and run history
checks: Repair reruns only the failed task

days.topic: Databricks SQL Warehouses and Query Optimisation
days.lab_task: Load test a dashboard with 30 concurrent users, size the warehouse and scaling, speed up the slowest query with a materialised view and set an alert on daily revenue.
days.deliverable: Load test results, warehouse settings and alert

days.lab_task: Share a gold table with a partner workspace, share a filtered view with an external recipient reading it from pandas, and audit what was read.
days.deliverable: Share configuration, recipient output and audit query

days.topic: Machine Learning with MLflow on Databricks
days.lab_task: Train a churn model with autologging, compare runs, register the best model in Unity Catalog with a champion alias and score customers in a batch job.
days.deliverable: Experiment, registered model and scored table

days.lab_task: Build customer feature tables with timestamps, create a training set with point-in-time lookups and train a model that looks up the same features when scoring.
days.deliverable: Feature tables, training set and model
checks: No feature values from after the label date
Lineage shows which models use the table

days.topic: Slowly Changing Dimensions and Dimensional Models in Delta
subtopics: SCD type 1 and type 2 with MERGE
days.lab_task: Build a sales star schema with a type 2 customer dimension using MERGE, identity surrogate keys and declared keys, and load facts that handle late-arriving customers.
days.deliverable: Model scripts, tables and tests
checks: Old and new versions kept with dates
Load a fact for an unknown customer
Linked to a placeholder and fixed later

subtopics: What to monitor in data platforms
System tables for jobs and queries
days.lab_task: Set up monitoring on the gold sales table, build an operations dashboard from job system tables and create alerts for failed runs, late data and a sudden drop in row counts.
days.deliverable: Monitors, operations dashboard and alerts

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with the Databricks Terraform Provider
subtopics: Clusters, policies and permissions as code
days.lab_task: Manage catalogs, schemas, grants and compute policies with Terraform, import one existing catalog, and review a plan that changes permissions before applying it.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, plan output and applied state
checks: Run terraform plan after no changes

days.topic: Databricks on Azure, AWS and GCP
subtopics: What is the same on every cloud
Azure Databricks integration with Entra ID and ADLS
Databricks on AWS with S3 and IAM
days.lab_task: Configure external locations with storage credentials on Azure ADLS and AWS S3, read the same dataset on each and write a comparison of identity, storage and networking set-up.
days.deliverable: External location configuration and comparison
checks: Dataset read from ADLS with the Entra ID managed identity
Dataset read from S3 with the IAM role credential

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, review every wrong answer against the documentation, build a weak-areas list and repeat a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list
checks: Each linked to a documentation page

days.lab_task: Build a streaming orders lakehouse: Kafka orders and CDC customers into a declarative pipeline with expectations, SCD type 2 dimensions, fine-grained access, monitoring, deployment through bundles and CI, and a share for a partner.
days.deliverable: Bundle repository, pipeline, monitors, share and demo recording
checks: Handled as designed and visible in metrics
Prod updated from a merged pull request
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior data engineers, platform owners and architects. Covers enterprise lakehouse architecture, multi-workspace Unity Catalog, network security, stateful streaming, performance at scale, cost governance, data mesh, migrations, Mosaic AI model serving and vector search, RAG and agents, MLOps, Genie, data applications, disaster recovery, backfills, open table formats, platform automation, production troubleshooting and the Data Engineer Professional exam.
prerequisites: Has run Databricks pipelines in production
Knows Unity Catalog, declarative pipelines and Asset Bundles
Understands cloud networking and identity on at least one cloud
outcomes: Run streaming and batch at scale with controlled cost
Deliver AI applications on governed data
Operate, recover and troubleshoot the platform

subtopics: Workspace topology by environment and business unit
Identity design with SCIM and groups
Reviewing architecture against the Well-Architected lakehouse
days.lab_task: Design the lakehouse for a bank with three business units and strict separation of production data: workspaces, catalogs, storage, identity and data flows, recorded as decision records and reviewed against the Well-Architected lakehouse pillars.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, decision records and review checklist
checks: Production data separated by catalog and storage
Each decision has options and reasons

subtopics: Sharing across regions with Delta Sharing
days.lab_task: Bind catalogs so finance data is visible only in finance workspaces, share a dataset from an EU metastore to a US workspace and federate a Snowflake database for read access.
days.deliverable: Binding configuration, share and federation setup
checks: Open the finance catalog from another workspace
Data available in the US workspace
Rows returned with Unity Catalog permissions applied

subtopics: Private Link and front-end and back-end connectivity
tools: Azure Databricks or Databricks on AWS
days.lab_task: Deploy a workspace with VNet injection or a customer VPC, Private Link, IP access lists, serverless egress rules and customer-managed keys using Terraform, and test that public access is blocked.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, network diagram and access tests
checks: Open the workspace from a public IP
Call an unapproved internet host from serverless
Customer-managed key used for managed storage

days.topic: Advanced Streaming: Stateful Processing and Exactly-Once
days.lab_task: Build a fraud detection stream that tracks per-card state with transformWithState, joins with merchant events within time limits, writes exactly once and survives a schema change and restart.
days.deliverable: Streaming code, state metrics and recovery notes
checks: Stream continues after the planned change

days.lab_task: Benchmark the five costliest jobs, apply skew handling, clustering and compute changes, and add a performance regression test that fails if run time grows by more than 20 percent.
days.deliverable: Benchmark report and regression test
checks: Run time and cost improved for at least three jobs
Cause identified from the query profile

days.topic: Cost Governance: Budgets, Policies and System Tables
days.lab_task: Set tagging standards and compute policies for three teams, build a showback dashboard from billing system tables, set budgets with alerts and cut the top waste source.
days.deliverable: Policies, showback dashboard, budgets and savings report

days.topic: Data Mesh and Data Products on Databricks
subtopics: Quality and SLAs for data products
When data mesh is the wrong choice
days.lab_task: Define two domain data products with contracts, SLAs and owners, publish them in Unity Catalog with documentation and quality monitors, and consume one from another domain.
days.deliverable: Contracts, published products and consumer example
checks: Find the product in Catalog Explorer
objectives: Decide when to use data mesh

days.topic: Migrating from Hadoop and Legacy Warehouses
subtopics: Hive and HDFS to Delta and Unity Catalog
Warehouse migration from Teradata, Oracle or SQL Server
Running old and new in parallel
days.lab_task: Assess a sample Hive and SQL Server estate, migrate two tables and three stored procedures to Delta and Databricks SQL, validate data with row counts and checksums and write the cutover plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment, migrated objects, validation report and cutover plan

days.topic: Mosaic AI: Model Serving and Vector Search
subtopics: AI Gateway: rate limits, guardrails and usage tracking
Cost and latency for AI workloads
days.lab_task: Serve the churn model as a real-time endpoint, create a Vector Search index synced from a documents table, classify support tickets with an AI function in SQL and add rate limits through AI Gateway.
days.deliverable: Endpoints, index and SQL classification results
checks: Prediction returned under the latency target

days.topic: Building RAG and Agent Applications on Databricks
subtopics: Agent frameworks and tools in Unity Catalog
days.lab_task: Build an assistant that answers policy questions from company documents and looks up order status through a Unity Catalog function tool, evaluate it on 30 questions with MLflow and deploy it with tracing.
days.deliverable: Agent code, evaluation results and deployed endpoint
checks: Tool called and the right answer returned
Ask as a user without document access

days.lab_task: Build an MLOps flow for the churn model: scheduled training, automatic validation against the champion, approval before promotion, inference logging and drift monitoring that triggers retraining.
days.deliverable: Bundle, pipeline runs and monitoring dashboard

subtopics: Instructions, example queries and trusted assets
Limits and when to use dashboards instead
days.lab_task: Create a Genie space on the sales gold tables, add instructions and example queries, benchmark it with 25 business questions, fix the failures and confirm row filters still apply.
days.deliverable: Genie space configuration and benchmark results
checks: Accuracy recorded before and after changes
Only their region's data in answers

days.topic: Data Applications with Databricks Apps and Lakebase
days.lab_task: Build a Streamlit app where account managers view churn scores from a synced Lakebase table and record follow-up actions back to Lakebase, deployed with a bundle and using the user's permissions.
days.deliverable: App code, bundle and demo recording
checks: Open the app as two users
Saved in Lakebase and visible on reload

subtopics: What needs protecting: data, code, metadata and identities
days.lab_task: Write a DR plan for the sales platform with RPO and RTO targets, replicate critical tables to a second region, re-deploy jobs there with code, run a failover test and time it.
days.deliverable: DR plan, replication jobs and test report
checks: Platform running in the second region within the RTO

subtopics: Idempotent writes with MERGE and replaceWhere
days.lab_task: Backfill two years of data in monthly chunks, re-run one month after a logic fix with replaceWhere, prove re-running the same day twice gives the same result and notify consumers.
days.deliverable: Backfill job, re-run evidence and consumer notice
checks: All months loaded with counts recorded

days.topic: Open Table Formats: Delta, Iceberg and UniForm
subtopics: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Apache Hudi
Managed Iceberg tables in Unity Catalog
Interoperability with Snowflake, Trino and others
days.lab_task: Enable UniForm on a Delta table, read it as Iceberg from an external engine through the Unity Catalog Iceberg REST endpoint and compare features with a managed Iceberg table.
days.deliverable: Table configuration, external read output and comparison
checks: External reader sees the new data

days.lab_task: Automate onboarding of a new team (groups, catalog, compute policies, budget and starter bundle) with the SDK and Terraform, and report adoption across teams from system tables.
days.deliverable: Onboarding automation and adoption report
checks: All resources created in one run
Active users and jobs per team

subtopics: An incident method for data platforms
Using system tables and logs together
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected incidents (executor out of memory, a stuck stream, an expired credential, a lock conflict on MERGE and a slow dashboard query), fix each and write a post-incident review for one.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Concurrent writers identified with a fix

days.lab_task: Take a timed professional-level practice exam, review wrong answers by domain, practise ten scenario questions with a partner and take a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores, review notes and final plan

days.lab_task: Deliver a lakehouse platform for a case enterprise: secure multi-workspace design in Terraform, streaming and batch pipelines with idempotent backfills, data products, a governed RAG assistant, cost governance and a tested DR failover, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, code repositories, test reports and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
